{"fragment": true, "screens": [{"tag": "screen", "attrs": {"backgroundColor": "md_transparent", "flags": "wfNoBorder", "name": "MenuSort", "position": "fill", "resolution": "1920,1080"}, "children": [{"tag": "applet", "attrs": {"type": "onContentChanged"}, "children": null, "text": "from enigma import ePoint, eSize, getDesktop, gRGB, BT_ALPHABLEND
from Components.Label import Label
from Components.Pixmap import Pixmap
from Components.Addons.Pager import Pager
from Components.Addons.ScreenHeader import ScreenHeader
from Components.Addons.MainMenu import MainMenu as MainMenuAddon
from Tools.Directories import resolveFilename, fileExists, SCOPE_CURRENT_SKIN
from Tools.LoadPixmap import LoadPixmap
from skin import parseRadius, parseColor, parseFont, menuicons, parameters
try:
 from skin import setListAnimation # animation engine, not in every build
except ImportError:
 setListAnimation = None
# the menu window has a fixed width, whatever its entries: the list is 26 px narrower than the window (the frame
# around it). The list sizes itself between its minimum and maximum width, so both are the same.
menuWidth = 700
minWidth = menuWidth - 26
if "menu_list" not in self:
 radiusItem, edgeValueItem = parseRadius("12")
 self["menu_list"] = MainMenuAddon()
 self["menu_list"].connectRelatedElement("menu", self)
 self["menu_list"].GUIcreate(self.instance)
 self["menu_list"].instance.move(ePoint(108, 140))
 self["menu_list"].instance.resize(eSize(minWidth, 754))
 font = parseFont("md_title_large", ((1, 1), (1, 1)))
 self["menu_list"].font = font
 self["menu_list"].l.setFont(0, font)
 self["menu_list"].setMinWidth(str(minWidth))
 self["menu_list"].setMaxWidth(str(minWidth))
 self["menu_list"].setIconSize("48")
 self["menu_list"].setForegroundColor("md_on_surface")
 self["menu_list"].setForegroundColorSelected("md_inverse_on_surface")
 self["menu_list"].setItemHeight("58")
 # The selected item is the inverse pill (windowstyle); its icon is the filled one, <name>_selected.svg next to
 # the outlined icon of the menu, in the dark colour of the pill. The list builds a row whenever it paints it,
 # so the row that is selected at that moment is the one that gets the filled icon.
 # An applet runs as exec(code, globals(), locals()): a function defined here does not see the names of the
 # applet (its imports, menuList), so everything it uses is bound as a default argument.
 menuList = self["menu_list"]
 def selectedIcon(key, cache={}, menuicons=menuicons, parameters=parameters, resolveFilename=resolveFilename,
 skinScope=SCOPE_CURRENT_SKIN, fileExists=fileExists, LoadPixmap=LoadPixmap):
 if key not in cache:
 icon = None
 path = menuicons.get(key, menuicons.get("default", ""))
 if path.endswith(".svg"):
 path = resolveFilename(skinScope, path[:-4] + "_selected.svg")
 if fileExists(path):
 icon = LoadPixmap(path, cached=True, width=parameters.get("MenuIconSize", (50, 50))[0], height=0)
 cache[key] = icon
 return cache[key]
 def buildSelectedRow(*item, menuList=menuList, buildRow=menuList.buildEntry, selectedIcon=selectedIcon):
 if len(item) >= 6 and item[5]:
 rows = menuList.source.list
 # the selection is source.index, which the list sets when it changes (MainMenu.selectionChanged); not
 # instance.getCurrentIndex(): painting moves the cursor of the list onto each row in turn, so it
 # is the row that is painted, and every row would get the filled icon
 index = menuList.source.index or 0
 if 0 <= index < len(rows) and rows[index][2] == item[2] and rows[index][0] == item[0]:
 icon = selectedIcon(item[2])
 if icon:
 item = item[:5] + (icon,) + item[6:]
 return buildRow(*item)
 menuList.l.setBuildFunc(buildSelectedRow)
 self["menu_list"].instance.setItemCornerRadius(radiusItem, edgeValueItem)
 self["menu_list"].instance.setWrapAround(True)
 if setListAnimation:
 setListAnimation(self["menu_list"].instance, self.skinName, {"name": "menu_list", "render": "Listbox"})
 
menu_list_size = self["menu_list"].instance.size()
 
radiusBLayer, edgeValueBLayer = parseRadius("16")
radiusTLayer, edgeValueTLayer = parseRadius("14")

if "blayer" not in self:
 self["blayer"] = Label()
 self["blayer"].GUIcreate(self.instance)
 self["blayer"].instance.setCornerRadius(radiusBLayer, edgeValueBLayer)
 self["blayer"].instance.setBackgroundColor(parseColor("md_surface_container_high"))
 self["blayer"].instance.move(ePoint(96,54))
 self["blayer"].setZPosition(-7)
self["blayer"].instance.resize(eSize(menu_list_size.width() + 26,972))

if "tlayer" not in self:
 self["tlayer"] = Label()
 self["tlayer"].GUIcreate(self.instance)
 self["tlayer"].instance.setCornerRadius(radiusTLayer, edgeValueTLayer)
 self["tlayer"].instance.setBackgroundColor(parseColor("md_surface"))
 self["tlayer"].instance.move(ePoint(98,120))
 self["tlayer"].setZPosition(-6)
self["tlayer"].instance.resize(eSize(menu_list_size.width() + 22,840))

if "pager" not in self:
 self["pager"] = Pager()
 self["pager"].connectRelatedElement("menu", self)
 self["pager"].GUIcreate(self.instance)
 self["pager"].instance.move(ePoint(108, 907))
 
self["pager"].instance.resize(eSize(menu_list_size.width(), 25))

if "header" not in self:
 self["header"] = ScreenHeader()
 self["header"].connectRelatedElement("Image,Title,ScreenPath", self)
 self["header"].GUIcreate(self.instance)
 self["header"].instance.setBackgroundColor(parseColor("md_surface_container_high"))
 self["header"].instance.move(ePoint(108,56))
 self["header"].titleForeground = parseColor("md_primary").argb()
 self["header"].pathForeground = parseColor("md_primary").argb()
 self["header"].backgroundColor = parseColor("md_surface_container_high").argb()
 self["header"].l.setFont(0, parseFont("md_title_small_emphasized", ((1, 1), (1, 1))))
 self["header"].l.setFont(1, parseFont("md_label_small_emphasized", ((1, 1), (1, 1))))
 self["header"].l.setFont(2, parseFont("md_headline_large_emphasized", ((1, 1), (1, 1))))
self["header"].instance.resize(eSize(menu_list_size.width() - 10,60))
self["header"].onContainerShown()"}, {"tag": "ePixmap", "attrs": {"alphatest": "blend", "pixmap": "buttons/key_prev.png", "position": "30,1031", "size": "52,38"}, "children": null, "text": null}, {"tag": "ePixmap", "attrs": {"alphatest": "blend", "pixmap": "buttons/key_next.png", "position": "82,1031", "size": "52,38"}, "children": null, "text": null}], "text": null}]}
